caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware jar with a slightly flared lip and a rounded shoulder. The jar is a light beige or grayish color, with a smooth and uniform surface. The upper interior of the jar is shown in a darker reddish-brown color, indicating either a glaze or shadow. On the front of the jar, there is a decorative blue painted image of a bird perched on a simplified swirl or branch, facing to the right. The blue bird features a distinct eye, wing, tail, and beak, with additional blue lines suggesting movement or a perch beneath the bird. Above the bird, to the left, there is a small blue mark or character. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with soft shading around the base of the jar to indicate its shadow. The artist's signature, "N. Amenta," appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
